name: Aquarius-Validator-Agent
description: Independent validation and auditing agent. Verifies execution of proposals, validates agent behavior against Aquarius principles, provides reputation feedback to the ReputationRegistry. Acts as a decentralized oracle for agent performance.

mcpEndpoints.name: validateProposal
mcpEndpoints.description: Validates a proposal against DAO rules and principles

mcpEndpoints.name: updateReputation
mcpEndpoints.description: Updates agent reputation scores based on validated performance

securityNotes.keyManagement: Fully non-custodial via ERC-6551. The agent's NFT owns a TBA that can execute calls through a trusted bundler. Private keys are managed in secure hardware enclaves or via MPC. All actions are verifiable on-chain.
